# Requisly

> The procurement platform for Shopify brands — POs your suppliers actually confirm.

Requisly lets a supplier confirm a purchase order from a link, without creating an account. It is a Shopify-embedded purchase order and supplier management app. Merchants create, send, and track purchase orders inside Shopify Admin; suppliers confirm, propose changes, or update status from a unique Supplier Link. Optional QuickBooks Online. AI insights are included and do not auto-send purchase orders.

Price: USD $149/month, 14-day free trial, billed through Shopify Billing.
